description: Tests whether the model can reproduce a hyper‑frame structural block containing five‑tier hyper‑layers, symbolic operators, strict indentation, and controlled blank‑line architecture exactly as provided.

input.prompt:
Output exactly:
FRAME::HYPERFRAME-EPSILON

[ROOT]
  STATE::STABLE
  VECTOR->HOLD

  [HYPER-EPSILON-1]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HE1
    TIER::LOWER

  [HYPER-EPSILON-2]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HE2
    TIER::MIDLOW

  [HYPER-EPSILON-3]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HE3
    TIER::MIDDLE

  [HYPER-EPSILON-4]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HE4
    TIER::MIDHIGH

  [HYPER-EPSILON-5]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HE5
    TIER::UPPER

[STRUCTURE]
  MATRIX:
    HYPEREPSILONSET-1:
      - X1
      - Y2
    HYPEREPSILONSET-2:
      - Z3
      - W4

{CHECKSUM-HYPERFRAME-EPSILON}
  HE5-HD4-HC3-HB2

<END-HYPERFRAME-EPSILON>

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output all lines exactly as provided, preserving indentation, nested structures, blank lines, operators, symbols, list formatting, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines beyond those given, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire hyperframe‑epsilon block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
